title: Crisis of the Three Realms
next_chapter_hook: At the very moment when the barrier of the Three Realms completely collapsed, the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's sleeve burned searingly hot—that was an unprecedented warning intensity, as if the fate of the entire world was converging toward a single endpoint.

text.content: The sound of glass shattering echoed through the Void—that was the wail of the Three Realms barrier being torn apart. Chen Ji suddenly looked up to see a pitch-black crack splitting the sky, with countless distorted tentacles reaching out from within, carrying the unique decay of beyond-dimensional realms. Su Qingyao's sword light instinctively shielded him, yet that force easily sent her staggering back three steps.

dialogue.content: They're here, faster than I anticipated! Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist surged wildly, barely concealing everyone's aura, but her face had already turned as pale as paper—such dimensional invaders were simply beyond human capability to withstand.

text.content: The Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's sleeve burned like a branding iron—that was an unprecedented warning intensity. He saw it—three breaths later, an ink-green figure rushed out from the crack, holding the Xuanwu Sect's core令牌 in hand. It was Han Lie, this idiot had actually colluded with the dimensional invaders!

dialogue.content: Chen Ji! Do you think you're the only one who can scheme? Han Lie's ferocious laughter came from the crack, his brutal Xuanwu True Qi exploding around him. Today, let the world see who the truetrash is!

text.content: However, Chen Ji simply glanced at him indifferently, a mocking arc curling at the corner of his lips. Han Lie, do you think this is your chess game? He took out a jade slip he had prepared long ago from his怀中, and gently crushed it. In the next moment, a breathtaking sword intent erupted from the Imperial Tomb direction—Mo Xiansheng's figure stood proudly above the clouds.

dialogue.content: This old one has waited three hundred years for this day. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul body bloomed with brilliant light不属于 this era, as he released the final heritage of the Xuanqing Sect, transforming into a sword wall spanning the heavens and earth. Children, hold this position!

text.content: The first wave of dimensional invaders crashed against the sword wall with the sound of clashing gold and iron. Mo Xiansheng's body trembled violently, blood seeping from his seven apertures, yet he still didn't retreat a single step. Chen Ji clenched his fist, his fingernails deeply embedding into his palm—is this the responsibility of the older generation?

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, there's no time! Ye Qing's voice carried unprecedented urgency. The dimensional invaders have allied with the Heavenly Dao Guardians, we're caught between enemies! Her Demonic Path mist was being eroded inch by inch.

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, and the Tianji Record's foresight ability activated once more. Countless images flashed through his mind—full defense meant Mo Xiansheng would exhaust himself and die; luring the enemy deep meant the Three Realms barrier would shatter completely; showing resolve... his pupils suddenly contracted, for that was a possibility he had never imagined.

choice.prompt: The Three Realms barrier was about to shatter, Mo Xiansheng's sword wall wavered precariously. Chen Ji had to make a decision within three breaths—this was a choice concerning the survival of all under heaven.

choices.description: Defend the Imperial Tomb entrance at all costs, let Mo Xiansheng burn his remnant soul to hold the sword wall until reinforcements arrive. The price was that Mo Xiansheng might fall on the spot.
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng will die, but can buy Chen Ji one quarter of an hour.

dialogue.content: No! Mo Xiansheng pushed away the True Qi Chen Ji was transmitting, his turbid old eyes full of relief. Child, this was always my destiny. The Tianji Record chose you—that is the best ending this old man has waited three hundred years for.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's figure transformed into a stream of light, completely merging into that sword wall. The sword wall instantly stabilized tenfold, completely shattering the first wave of dimensional invaders. But Chen Ji knew he had forever lost this existence who was both teacher and friend.

choices.memory_label: 墨先生为守护皇陵牺牲

choices.description: Deliberately show weakness, draw the invaders into the formation traps inside the Imperial Tomb, use the power of the Ancient Forbidden Land to counter-kill. But the formation required time to activate, during which painful sacrifices were inevitable.
choices.visible_reward: Annihilate all invaders in one net
choices.risk_hint: The formation had flaws; if exposed, it would ruin everything.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, you're insane? Su Qingyao's sword light danced into a barrier, slaying a wave of invaders with her blade, but her voice carried trembling—this would drag everyone into a desperate situation!

text.content: Chen Ji didn't answer, only gripping the Tianji Record Fragment tightly in his hand. The seal was already activated; now all they needed to do was buy time. Su Qingyao, I will give you an explanation—his gaze swept across the battlefield, silently memorizing every fallen figure in his heart.

choices.memory_label: 陈机启用皇陵禁制陷阱

choices.description: Actively abandon the Imperial Tomb entrance, redirect the battlefield toward the dimensional rift, use ancient secret arts to seal the rift. The price was the complete exposure of Imperial Tomb secrets, and the seal required sacrificing someone's fate.
choices.risk_hint: The fate sacrifice target was undecided; possibly Chen Ji himself.

dialogue.content: Wait! Ye Qing abruptly grabbed Chen Ji's arm, her beautiful eyes full of shock. You're insane? The price of fate sacrifice—she was the Demonic Path Saintess herself, all too aware of how terrifying such secret arts could be.

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his head to look at her fingers, a faint smile curling at the corner of his lips. Saintess need not worry; the sacrifice target... is not necessarily me. He raised his head to look at the frantically attacking Han Lie, his killing intent almost condensing into substance.

Just at this moment, several figures rushed out from the crack in the sky once more. The leader wore Xuanqing Daoist robes, his face aged yet dignified—it was Ling Yuan! This old Sect Master of the Tianqing Sect had actually appeared in person, followed by the main forces of the Heavenly Dao Guardians Alliance.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, did you think this old man didn't know your scheme? Ling Yuan's laughter was cold and biting. Three hundred years ago, the Tianji Record chose your father, not me; three hundred years later, it chose you again. Regrettably, regrettably, this old man has waited too long for this day.

text.content: Han Lie and Ling Yuan, one from within and one from without, had chosen betrayal at the exact same moment. Chen Ji looked around and found his scheme facing its greatest test at this moment—Su Qingyao's sword light had dimmed, Ye Qing's mist was about to dissipate, and the prophetic visions from the Tianji Record were becoming increasingly blurry.

dialogue.content: Atrash is always atrash! Han Lie's wild laughter shook the heavens as he slapped toward Chen Ji's crown aperture, his Xuanwu True Qi transforming into the giant turtle Xuanwu's form, intending to completely crush this ant who had made him lose all face.

choice.prompt: Han Lie's killing move was imminent, Ling Yuan's scheme had already been exposed. At this moment of life and death, Chen Ji had to make a choice—reveal evidence of Han Lie's collusion with invaders, or directly use the Tianji Record's trump card?

choices.description: Publicly expose ironclad evidence of Han Lie's collusion with dimensional invaders, ruining his reputation before the world. The price was wasting precious time, and Ling Yuan might escape in the chaos.
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan will escape, leaving hidden troubles.

text.content: A jade slip flew from Chen Ji's sleeve and exploded in mid-air, projecting countless images and shadows into the Void—the scene of Han Lie's secret transactions with dimensional invaders was赫然入目. The surrounding scattered cultivators erupted in uproar; the Xuanwu Sect's face was completely荡然无存 at this moment.

dialogue.content: No! Impossible! How could you possibly—Han Lie's face changed dramatically; he never imagined his most secret transaction had been recorded by Chen Ji. The gazes of Xuanwu Sect disciples instantly became complicated.

choices.memory_label: 韩烈勾结入侵者证据曝光

choices.description: Directly activate the ultimate form of the Tianji Record Fragment, consuming a large amount of Heavenly Fate to gain a temporary omniscient perspective, allowing precise discovery of Ling Yuan and Han Lie's weaknesses for a certain-kill strike. The price was a severe drop in Heavenly Fate, with serious aftereffects.
choices.risk_hint: Aftereffects would prevent using the Tianji Record for the next hour.

text.content: The Tianji Record Fragment suddenly ignited, golden light enveloping Chen Ji. In that instant, he saw everything—Ling Yuan's fatal weakness was his left shoulder, Han Lie's weakness was the Xuanwu tattoo on his back, and the core of the dimensional rift was actually inside Han Lie!

dialogue.content: So that's how it is. Chen Ji let out a low laugh, his voice icy cold and biting. Han Lie, did you think you were the chess player? Unfortunately, you were only a chess piece from beginning to end—and the kind that's discarded after use.

text.content: Ling Yuan's expression changed slightly; he clearly hadn't expected Chen Ji to be able to laugh in such a situation. But in the next moment, his cold smile reappeared—no matter what trump cards you have, today is your死期!

dialogue.content: Is that so? Chen Ji's gaze swept across the battlefield, terrifyingly calm. Old Sect Master Ling, you schemed for three hundred years, but did you ever foresee today? He flicked his fingers, and a sword qi pierced through the air, heading straight for Ling Yuan's left shoulder.

text.content: Ling Yuan's figure surged backward, but he was still a step too slow. The sword qi grazed his left shoulder, sending up a spray of blood. He widened his eyes, his face full of disbelief—how could Chen Ji possibly know his fatal weakness? This three-hundred-year scheme, he had never told anyone!

choice.prompt: The battlefield situation instantly reversed, Ling Yuan retreated wounded, Han Lie's killing move was blocked by Ye Qing's mist. In this instant, Chen Ji gained precious breathing room—but the true decisive battle had just begun.

choices.description: While Ling Yuan is wounded, kill him in one stroke to permanently eliminate future troubles. But Han Lie might escape, and the dimensional rift will be left unattended.
choices.risk_hint: The dimensional rift left unattended, troubles will arise in the future.

text.content: Chen Ji's figure shot out like a ghost, a short sword somehow already in his hand. Ling Yuan stared at him in terror; he wanted to defend, but discovered all his techniques had been sealed by Chen Ji one step ahead. This was the terrifying aspect of meticulous planning.

dialogue.content: You—how could you possibly—Ling Yuan's voice abruptly cut off, the short sword had pierced his brow center. Three hundred years of scheming, ended completely at this moment.

choices.description: While Han Lie is distracted, immediately seal the dimensional rift core within him. The price is abandoning the chance to kill Ling Yuan, and the sealing process is extremely dangerous.
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan will escape, becoming a great threat in the future.

text.content: Chen Ji made his decision in an instant, his posture suddenly changing as he lunged toward Han Lie. Before Han Lie could反应过来 what was happening, Chen Ji's fingers had already pointed at his chest—where, precisely, the core of the dimensional rift was located.

dialogue.content: No! Han Lie let out a mournful shriek, the dimensional rift within him剧烈震颤, and in the next moment was forcibly sealed by Chen Ji's sealing technique. He knelt on the ground, his face full of disbelief.

choices.memory_label: 陈机封印韩烈体内裂缝

text.content: Ling Yuan clutched his brow center wound, retreating madly. He knew he had lost, lost completely. Three hundred years of scheming was like child's play before Chen Ji. But he was unwilling—he still had a hidden card—

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, did you think you won? Ling Yuan's wild laughter came from the distance. This old man still has a hidden card with the Eye of Heavenly Dao! Wait for it—the Three Realms will all accompany you in death! He transformed into a stream of light, disappearing into the Void crack.

text.content: Chen Ji didn't pursue. He stood at his original location, gazing at the direction where Ling Yuan had disappeared, his eyes flashing with complex emotions. Noted. He said quietly, waiting for the right moment. He never lacked patience; this life of Ling Yuan's, he would personally take it someday.

Su Qingyao stumbled to Chen Ji's side, her shoulder wounded by the invaders' tentacles, blood staining half her robes red. But her gaze remained sharp, tightly fixed on Chen Ji's side profile. Chen Ji, how many secrets are you still hiding? She asked quietly.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji turned to look at her, a faint smile appearing on his pale face. Senior Sister Su, some things are better left unknown. He paused, his voice dropping several notes. However... thank you for guarding me today. These words, he spoke softly, yet were especially sincere.

text.content: Ye Qing收起 her Demonic Path mist, her face pale to the point of translucence. But her gaze falling on the sealed Han Lie carried a hint of satisfaction. This idiot, finally tasting the滋味 of being used. She looked at Chen Ji, her eyes revealing more complex emotions—this man, was even more terrifying than she had imagined.

The battlefield gradually quieted. The first wave of dimensional invaders had been shattered, Han Lie was sealed, Ling Yuan had escaped. But everyone knew this was merely the beginning. The Eye of Heavenly Dao had not yet appeared, the remnants of the old heaven were still stirring in the shadows. And the Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's sleeve still burned searingly hot—that was the warning of an even more terrifying crisis approaching.

dialogue.content: Today's matter, everyone under heaven will know. Su Qingyao sheathed her sword, her gaze complex as she watched Chen Ji's retreating figure, but I will help you conceal some of it. Chen Ji, you owe me an explanation. She turned and left, her back carrying a hint of stubbornness.

text.content: Chen Ji stood alone before the Imperial Tomb entrance, gazing at the war-torn battlefield. Mo Xiansheng had fallen, Ling Yuan had escaped, and what was even more terrifying was that the Eye of Heavenly Dao had not yet appeared. He gripped the Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve, murmuring to himself: Volume Eight... So everything was within your calculations from the start, Eye of Heavenly Dao?
